data.narrative:
Zoo is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $35.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of nine robotics and manufacturing peers—one public (277810.KQ) and eight private companies including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI—though direct peer comparables at Zoo's stage and valuation tier proved insufficient for traditional median peer analysis.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology was the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($36M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement in the sector yielded an implied valuation of $89M. This method assumes Zoo's fundraise reflects reasonable market validation at entry but does not incorporate revenue multiples, unit economics, or relative competitive positioning—data not available in this assessment.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $75M to $102M, centered at $89M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the absence of Zoo-specific financial metrics, revenue run rate, or customer traction data; the limited peer set at Zoo's precise stage and scale; and the proxy assumption that total raised equates to fair-value entry pricing. Additional clarity on revenue, unit economics, and competitive differentiation within manufacturing robotics would narrow this range materially.
